scope: Final-revision documentation consistency only; no product acceptance

tool_result.text:
No blocking findings.

Verdict — overall_correctness: correct. Explanation: The amended AGENTS low-model entry, INDEX §1, plan §2 intro/§3/§17.1–17.9/§17.13, design §12–13 and the state header keep the current gate, the full-delivery authorization (not yet activated new allowance), the #18 fixed-head/zero-fee scope, and the full product endpoint consistent; the published Issue 7/8/9/10 bodies match the local copies, and nothing promotes old assets into current-product proof or narrows/expands acceptance. Confidence: 0.88.

Evidence checked (read-only; no edits, builds or checks run):
- Baseline `_stage-amz-control/handoff-hardening-20261018T132906Z/before.zip` + `before-manifest.json` diffed against current `AGENTS.md`, `docs/INDEX.md`, `docs/product-v2-refactor-plan.md`, `docs/product-v2-refactor-design.md`, `_working/amz-listing-kit-product-v2/state.md`. Only plan and state changed in the last (third) revision; AGENTS/INDEX/design hashes are stable across revisions.
- §2.1: the ```text Goal fence is byte-identical to baseline; only the framing paragraph changed, and it now defers execution to §17.13/state without rewriting history. Machine block changes are limited to `latest_audit` and `updated_at`; `status: paused`, binding evidence, phase/task progress untouched. The new `latest_audit` target satisfies the J8 guard (exists, contains NOT-AUTHORITY in its head).
- Final tightening is present and consistent: §17.2 item 3 (re-check review/required CI at the actual final merge head; record merge SHA + deploy/HTTPS/fingerprint/finalize along the existing chain; finalize-cleanup failure is not treated as a product rollback; blocked release does not stop other authorized offline work), §17.6 first two bullets (sealed-hash-directed ledger takeover preserving newer working records; authorization idempotency key `complete-product-authorization-20261018T114240Z` explicitly not a native Goal ID; product Goal ID ≠ #9 slice), §17.13 item 5 ("不重建已完成部分；B1–B3剩余合同、B4人因、B5真实品质照常实施" — no accidental narrowing).
- Acceptance preserved throughout: five-purpose/five-image, two adapters, two rework modes, two ZIPs, final same-candidate two rounds, protected release + same-origin recovery; C15/C17 remain external human gates (not auto-signed, not made engineering preconditions); fee/Unknown/clean-cutover stops intact.
- Issues: `issue-7/8/9/10-after.md` match the published bodies read back live via `gh issue view` for all four (content identical; remote has one extra trailing newline each, +1 byte, which also explains `issue-publication.json`'s `body_bytes` being the local counts). Originals are preserved in `issue-*-before.json`; #10 comments referenced by Issue 7 (`6235888287`, `6244740125`) resolve to the recorded comment URLs; baseline 7/7 is kept as history with no V1/P0–P8 rebuild, and the blanket finalize-failure rollback is absent.
- PR #18 live read (`gh pr view 18`): head still `3dc0018689…`, OPEN/Draft, 8 commits, changedFiles 186, three checks COMPLETED SUCCESS — consistent with the state/plan claims; "deploy/finalize skipped" is taken from the recorded closeout (I did not re-derive step-level skips).

Boundaries and limits:
- I did not consult the native Goal (prior actual get returned Unknown tool, per instruction); all docs consistently keep it blocked, forbid faking/binding substitutes, and keep the new 5 CNY/12 image/4 assistance allowance unactivated.
- `handoff-hardening-20261018T132906Z/verification.json` is still `status: in_progress` with `cold_read: pending` and `checks: []`, while state's header and `latest_audit` point to it — accurate as a pointer today, but stage finalization must still record the final-revision checks/cold read, otherwise that pointer lags the amended docs.
- Two wording overlaps I judged non-blocking and reconcilable: Issue 9's "双轴最终审查" vs the closeout's two review axes ("双审"); Issue 8's "四段导航…（随B1–B3必要UI同步）" vs state/§17.13 "之后完成B4四段/稳定精看等完整人因" — both read as "necessary interface synced with the vertical; complete B4 human factors after", with navigation-first explicitly prohibited ("而非先改导航、后补合同").
- No product acceptance is implied by this review; it covers documentation consistency only, and does not sign pixels, UI behavior, C15/C17, or release.
